panels.description: Number of NVIDIA GPUs (last known during the selected time range). Expected: 8.
panels.title: GPUs

targets.expr: count(count by (job, instance, id) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range])))

count((last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_health{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) * on (job, instance, id) group_left (name, slot) max by (job, instance, id, name, slot) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range]))) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.description: Last known GPU inventory during the selected time range, so it remains visible while the host is powered off.
panels.title: GPU Inventory

targets.expr: idrac_pcie_device_health{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, id) group_left (name, slot) max by (job, instance, id, name, slot) (idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"})

list.description: Credential group from the Prometheus scrape config (own-dell, own-lenovo, pesso)
list.label: Group
list.name: group
